mechanism: Phenelzine (MAOI) potentiates the hypotensive effects of chlorthalidone through inhibition of norepinephrine metabolism, and chlorthalidone may cause hypokalemia increasing cardiac arrhythmia risk in combination with MAOI.
action: Monitor blood pressure closely; use chlorthalidone cautiously with phenelzine or consider alternative antihypertensive agent; monitor serum potassium regularly.
